This plot is small but it is part of my land, so when I buy fertilizer for the bigger fields I will spread a little here too. I always put manure on my root crops because it helps them grow big and strong. We plant our own cuttings from last season and do all the work ourselves—my wife and children help with the planting and harvesting. We do not spray chemicals on root crops here, and the rains are enough for this plot.
